legs.name: T>=5 (any Q)
legs.statement: No 4-Toffoli circuit computes F24 inversion at ANY qubit count Q (h-bits allowed as operand sources)
legs.model: kickmix model: classical reversible gates + MBU; paid ops = ccx (product of two distinct-wire values, transient affine shaping, targets any wire); ancilla count unrestricted; zero global phase; exact task
legs.completeness_note: rank proof, exhaustive over the complete first-op product menu: (1) rank span{d2(INV_b)} = 4; (2) any 4-product solution needs all four product d2s inside W := span{d2(INV_b)} (a 4-vector span containing the 4-dim W equals W); (3) the complete 171-product first-op menu has 31 products with d2 = 0 and 140 with d2 outside W, none nonzero inside W; (4) products involving h-bit operands have nonzero h-cross d2 coordinates (W is x-only) or d2 = 0. Hence no first product's d2 lies nonzero in W - contradiction. Cross-checked by exhaustive DFS (tsearch, 343 nodes) in the 2-ancilla model.

legs.name: Q>=9 at T=5
legs.statement: No 0-ancilla (Q=8) circuit computes F24 inversion with 5 Toffolis
legs.model: no ancilla: products land directly in h bits, operands = shaped x-wires only
legs.completeness_note: per-bit BFS over the complete product menu (products of affine 4-var pairs): bit 0 of INV is not the XOR of any <=4 menu products' d2 (searched exhaustively to depth 4); since each landed product contributes its d2 exactly, bit 0 needs >=5 products, contradicting T=5 with all 5 products consumed by bit 0 alone only if others need 0 (they need >=1 each: their d2s are nonzero)

legs.name: Q>=10 at T=5
legs.statement: No 1-ancilla (Q=9) circuit computes F24 inversion with 5 Toffolis
legs.model: one ancilla t: t-ops use x-affine operand pairs (MBU-freeable); h-ops use x-affine pairs or (t-prefix shaped & x-affine) pairs; free snapshots cx(t,h[b]) any time; free final affine assembly
legs.completeness_note: exhaustive DFS over (t truth table, accumulated h injections) with admissible rank pruning (missing d2 rank vs remaining ops); the operand menu at each node is the complete set of realizable products in the model; memoized

legs.name: Q>=10 at T=5, two ancillas (v3 sound subclass)
legs.statement: No circuit in the finalized sound two-ancilla model computes F24 inversion with 5 Toffolis
legs.model: two ancillas at Q=10 (existsearch.py v3): ancilla-targeted ops = MBU-safe x-affine pairs only; h-targeted ops = x/t/u/tu/h-source families; t/u truth-table state; basis-inclusive memo. STRICT SOUND SUBCLASS of Q=10 circuits - the paper's own (T=5, Q=10) construction uses operations outside this subclass, so this leg asserts no circuit in THIS model, not that no two-ancilla circuit exists
legs.completeness_note: exhaustive DFS over (t truth table, accumulated h injections, shared basis) with admissible rank pruning; basis-inclusive memo key (18,225 states); closed NOT FOUND at 74,594,457 nodes with no deadline hit (TIMEOUT would be recorded as inconclusive)

notes: The T>=5 leg is a rank argument, valid for ANY Q (any number of ancillas, h-bits as operand sources allowed). The Q>=9 and Q>=10 legs hold for 0 and 1 ancilla respectively. The two-ancilla leg is scoped to its stated sound subclass: the paper's own (T=5, Q=10) construction lies outside that subclass, so no leg asserts a universal two-ancilla impossibility.
All searches deterministic; node counts reproduce exactly.
